bullets.text: In Bharathiyar Nagar, high sea waves overflowed retaining walls and flooded homes, causing great distress to residents, so the office should monitor relief efforts.
Authorities issued loudspeaker warnings on ECR from Thiruvanmiyur to Uthandi as severe sea surges occurred, so the office must watch coastal safety measures.
Passengers fear Chennai Airport shutdown as heavy rains loom and planned stormwater drain work drags on, so the office should monitor drainage progress.
PMK MLA Sowmya Anbumani demanded that the government issue a formal notification recognizing Pallikaranai marshland, so the office should watch policy updates.
Police arrested a driver and seized a lorry smuggling sand from Nagari to Tiruttani via Ponpadi checkpoint, so the office should watch enforcement actions.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay inspected the Chembarambakkam reservoir, bringing focus to rainwater storage management, so the office should monitor water levels.
A weapons exhibition featuring historical firearms was held at the Tamil Nadu Special Police battalion training center in Avadi for students, so the office should watch youth outreach.
Tata Communications plans to invest up to $450 million to build a 10,000-kilometer AI super highway across India, so the office should support infrastructure growth.
OneQode secured 14 MW of AI capacity in Chennai through an agreement with AdaniConneX, so the office should watch regional technology investments.
MP Kanimozhi accused the TVK government of failing to control the prices of Aavin products, so the office should monitor political responses to the criticism.
